name: @agent-wingman/opencode-agent-wingman
description: Detector-first local struggle detection plugin for OpenCode.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts bin/replay.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm
scripts.package:check: bun run build && test -f dist/src/index.js && test -f dist/bin/replay.js && bun pm pack --dry-run
scripts.verify: bun test && bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run trace:replay && bun run smoke
